title: Transit pipeline: sig verified against pre-Path bytes but stored under post-Path CID
description: TRIGGER: Any article received via IHAVE/TAKETHIS on the transit peering path. BEHAVIOR: In transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs, the pipeline (1) snapshots original_bytes, (2) prepends a Path header hop to produce modified_bytes, (3) writes modified_bytes to IPFS producing a CID, (4) verifies the X-Stoa-Sig signature against original_bytes, then records the verification result keyed by that CID. The CID refers to the modified bytes. Any external party that fetches the block by CID and attempts to verify X-Stoa-Sig will compare the signature against bytes that include the extra Path hop the original signer never saw — verification always fails. The verification database entry records 'CID X is verified' but CID X cannot be independently verified.
notes: Research shows X-Stoa-Sig is local-only provenance tracking, not independently verifiable from IPFS by design. The CID (of modified bytes) is a consistent DB key for the pre-computed verification result; no code path re-verifies from IPFS. Fix: add comment to pipeline.rs clarifying the design intent.
